integrity: The proof uses an explicit cubic self-convolution identity, analytic reduction to two real variables, exact boundary comparison, and an exact rational Sturm certificate for the sole feasible critical point. Literature comparisons separate the unrestricted amplitude problem from prior maximum-norm, signed-idempotent, unimodular-phase, and consecutive-support results.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns the reduced frequency support \(\{0,1,3\}\) on the one-dimensional torus at exponent \(6\). It does not classify other three-point supports or exponents. The degree-ten optimizer is isolated exactly rather than expressed by radicals, and randomized checks are corroborative only.
title: Sharp \(L^2\to L^6\) norm for the Hardy–Littlewood frequency triple
